description: Microsoft Planetary Computer data catalogue is an open data portal listed in Microsoft Planetary Computer data catalogue, a cloud catalogue of environmental and geospatial data sets, published or maintained by Microsoft. The Planetary Computer catalogue lists environmental and Earth-observation collections (satellite imagery, land cover, weather and climate grids, elevation models, biodiversity) stored in Azure. Only the collections that describe infrastructure exposure, hazards or assets are catalogued as records of their own; the imagery and climate collections are outside this catalogue. Coverage: global, per collection. 138 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 5 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-planetary-computer-catalogue.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
